title: Quenched Saudi-Arabian Eggs Frittata
description: A unique and flavorful breakfast dish that combines traditional Middle Eastern ingredients with a modern twist. This recipe is perfect for a date night or a special occasion.
instructions: Crack the eggs into a large bowl and whisk them together with a pinch of salt and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped parsley and pomegranate seeds to the skillet and cook until the parsley is wilted.
Add the saffron threads to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Pour the egg mixture over the top of the skillet and cook until the eggs start to set.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and bake at 375°F for 15-20 minutes, or until the eggs are cooked through.
Remove the skillet from the oven and sprinkle with crumbled feta cheese.
Return the skillet to the stovetop and cook over low heat for 1-2 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and the frittata is heated through.
Slide the frittata out of the skillet onto a plate and serve hot.
Garnish with additional parsley and pomegranate seeds, if desired.
